# 10.00 USD moved from the cash box back to the bank. The file writes a cost on
# the outgoing split, and `applied_from_credit: "true"` beside it, which says
# the split was an owner's credit spent on a record.
#
# No record's lot holds the split, so the book does not bear the mark out. The
# split spends currency, and a cost on a split that spends currency is a figure
# nothing reads.
#
# Imported into `usd_moved_between_two_usd_accounts.txt`, which opens both
# accounts.
2026-02-02 * "Move 10 USD from the cash box back to the bank"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 10.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "10.00"
	Assets:Cash:USD -10.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		value: "-10.00"
		cost_basis_cost: "1.35 CAD/USD"
		applied_from_credit: "true"
